title: Voice Connector as code for the Avaya coexistence trunk
scenario: During coexistence LFG's Avaya SBCEs trunk to the PSTN through Chime SDK Voice Connector. CloudFormation has no Chime SDK Voice resource types, so the proof-of-concept CDK stack uses custom resources, and the security review rejected it: no encryption, private CIDRs, plaintext credentials, one Region, no logs and settings that never update. Make it production-grade, asserted offline.
task: Two encrypted Voice Connectors (us-east-1, us-west-2) behind a Voice Connector group
Termination: public SBC CIDRs, calling regions, CPS from config; synth-time validation
Origination: TLS over TCP 5061 with priority/weight failover routes
SIP message and media metric logging; Put* calls on create and update
Termination credentials from Secrets Manager via a provider Lambda, least-privilege read
acceptance: Decoded SDK calls in the template match the trunk design
No plaintext password in the template; secret read scoped to one ARN
ANSWER.md explains each finding and remaining go-live work
